name: RingCentral
label: RingCentral — RingEX REST API + Team Messaging
description: RingCentral via the official RingEX REST API v1.0 plus Team Messaging. Base https://platform.ringcentral.com/restapi/v1.0. Docs: https://developers.ringcentral.com/api-reference and https://developers.ringcentral.com/guide/team-messaging/posting. OAuth JWT or 3-legged. Sandbox host is platform.devtest.ringcentral.com. SMS 10DLC. create-meeting was removed — the Programmable Meetings API is discontinued (https://developers.ringcentral.com/meetings-api). create-post uses POST /team-messaging/v1/chats/{chatId}/posts (not legacy /glip/...). listen = webhooks as BPMN message events. Handler: OfficialApiNode (api_spec.json). OUTPUT is {status,http_status,data} or {error}. Inbound provider events are BPMN message events (operation listen), not a Webhook node.
author: 5c8b0d45-1d10-4f2e-844c-2318af96b2fa

ports.name: input
ports.description: One RingCentral operation. Set operation plus the fields that operation needs. Do not put secrets on this port. Example: {"operation":"send-sms"}.

schema.label: operation
schema.description: Which official call to run. EXACT values: send-sms | send-fax | ringout | create-post | create-contact | update-contact | find-contact | listen. create-meeting was removed (Programmable Meetings API discontinued). listen / send-and-wait are kind:ingress — the handler does not open a socket; use a BPMN message start/catch/boundary event. Example: first verb.

schema.label: text
schema.description: SMS or Team Messaging post body. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: chatId
schema.description: Team Messaging chat id for create-post (POST /team-messaging/v1/chats/{chatId}/posts). Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: contactId
schema.description: Address-book contact id. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: phoneNumber
schema.description: Lookup number for find-contact. Purpose: operation input. Omit when unused.

schema.label: from
schema.description: Request-body parameter `from` for operations: send-sms, ringout.

schema.label: to
schema.description: Request-body parameter `to` for operations: send-sms, send-fax, ringout.

schema.label: coverIndex
schema.description: Request-body parameter `coverIndex` for operation: send-fax.

schema.label: playPrompt
schema.description: Request-body parameter `playPrompt` for operation: ringout.

schema.label: firstName
schema.description: Request-body parameter `firstName` for operations: create-contact, update-contact.

schema.label: lastName
schema.description: Request-body parameter `lastName` for operations: create-contact, update-contact.

schema.label: email
schema.description: Request-body parameter `email` for operations: create-contact, update-contact.

schema.label: coverPageText
schema.description: send-fax cover page text.

schema.label: homePhone
schema.description: create-contact / update-contact home phone.

schema.label: mobilePhone
schema.description: create-contact / update-contact mobile phone.

schema.label: company
schema.description: create-contact / update-contact company.

schema.label: startsWith
schema.description: Query-string parameter `startsWith` for operation: find-contact.

ports.name: output
ports.description: Result object. Success: {status:'ok', http_status, data}. Ingress operations return a message telling the operator to use a BPMN message event. Secrets never appear. Errors raise a BPMN error for the error boundary event (INVALID_INPUT, AUTH_FAILED, RATE_LIMITED, HTTP_<status>, REQUEST_FAILED); secrets are redacted.

schema.label: status
schema.description: Present on HTTP success. EXACT: ok.

schema.label: http_status
schema.description: Upstream HTTP status. Example: 200.

schema.label: data
schema.description: Parsed JSON body from the provider, or raw text if not JSON. Never contains secrets.

configurationParameters.label: Operation
configurationParameters.description: Default operation when INPUT omits operation. EXACT: send-sms, send-fax, ringout, create-post, create-contact, update-contact, find-contact, listen. create-meeting was removed (Programmable Meetings API discontinued). listen/send-and-wait instruct the operator to use BPMN message events.

configurationParameters.label: Access token
configurationParameters.description: RingCentral OAuth access token. Header Authorization: Bearer. StudioQuack secret. Never log. Never put on INPUT.

configurationParameters.label: Timeout (seconds)
configurationParameters.description: Connect+read timeout for each official HTTPS call. Positive integer. Default 25. 0/blank → 25.

configurationParameters.label: Webhook Key
configurationParameters.description: Engine Webhook API Key binding ($webhookKeyRef) routing inbound HTTP webhooks to this node.
